src:
MOV     DX, OFFSET ZM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 36h          ; DOS: free space on drive DL
MOV     DL, 26           ; 26 = Z: (1 = A here; 0 = the current drive)
INT     21h
CMP     AX, 0FFFFh       ; FFFFh: no such drive
JE      NONE1
MOV     BPS1, CX         ; keep the answer: printing changes it
MOV     FREE1, BX
MOV     TOTAL1, DX
CALL    PDEC             ; sectors per cluster
MOV     DX, OFFSET SPCM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AX, BPS1
CALL    PDEC
MOV     DX, OFFSET BPSM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AX, FREE1
CALL    PDEC
MOV     DX, OFFSET OFM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AX, TOTAL1
CALL    PDEC
MOV     DX, OFFSET FREEM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
NONE1:
MOV     DX, OFFSET BADM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 36h          ; a drive that cannot exist
MOV     DL, 27
INT     21h
CALL    PHEX             ; FFFF
MOV     DX, OFFSET CRLF
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h

ZM1     DB      "Z: $"
SPCM1   DB      " sectors x $"
BPSM1   DB      " bytes, $"
OFM1    DB      " of $"
FREEM1  DB      " clusters free", 13, 10, "$"
BADM1   DB      "drive 27: AX = $"
BPS1    DW      0
FREE1   DW      0
TOTAL1  DW      0
CRLF    DB      13, 10, "$"
PDEC    PROC    NEAR     ; print AX in decimal (changes AX BX CX DX)
MOV     BX, 10
XOR     CX, CX           ; digits on the stack
PDEC1:
XOR     DX, DX
DIV     BX               ; AX = AX / 10, DX = the last digit
PUSH    DX
INC     CX
OR      AX, AX
JNZ     PDEC1
PDEC2:
POP     DX               ; the digits come back first to last
ADD     DL, "0"
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
LOOP    PDEC2
RET
PDEC    ENDP
PHEX    PROC    NEAR     ; print AX as four hex digits (changes AX BX CX DX)
MOV     BX, AX
MOV     CX, 4
PHEX1:
PUSH    CX
MOV     CL, 4
ROL     BX, CL           ; the top digit to the bottom
POP     CX
MOV     DL, BL
AND     DL, 0Fh
ADD     DL, "0"
CMP     DL, "9"
JBE     PHEX2
ADD     DL, 7            ; "A" to "F"
PHEX2:
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
LOOP    PHEX1
RET
PHEX    ENDP
